clips.title: The story
paras: The Library Wing is a secluded hall inside Tyr's Hand Abbey, nestled within the Scarlet Crusade's heavily fortified redoubt in the Eastern Plaguelands. Once dedicated to holy study and contemplation, its shelves are now consumed by the zealous order's rigid dogma and propaganda. Members of the Crusade congregate here to study scripture and guard the sanctum's religious relics.

Situated off the central nave of Tyr's Hand Abbey opposite the martial quarters, the Library Wing reflects the ideological core of the Scarlet Crusade. Within these quiet stone alcoves, priests and crusaders immerse themselves in theological tracts, militant doctrines, and writings twisted by years of relentless warfare against the Scourge. Rather than preserving open scholarship, the texts sheltered here fuel the Crusade's paranoia, reinforcing their conviction that all outsiders carry the taint of corruption.

Beyond its collection of partisan scrolls and scriptures, the Library Wing is closely guarded by the Scarlet priesthood. Reaching its back rooms requires fighting through elite Scarlet defenders who treat the library as both a bastion of faith and an impenetrable fortress.
